#{tcCurlRoll.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} create_by, #{tcCurlRoll.createTime,jdbcType=DATE} create_time, #{tcCurlRoll.updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} update_by, #{tcCurlRoll.updateTime,jdbcType=DATE} update_time, #{tcCurlRoll.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} remark from dual
) b ON ( a.SIDEWALL_CODE = b.SIDEWALL_CODE AND a.del_flag = '0' )WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.CURL_LENGTH = b.CURL_LENGTH,
a.update_by = b.create_by, a.update_time = sysdate, a.remark = b.remark WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( a.id , a.SIDEWALL_CODE , a.CURL_LENGTH , a.create_by , a.create_time , a.remark, a.del_flag ) values( SEQ_PUBLIC.NEXTVAL, b.SIDEWALL_CODE , b.CURL_LENGTH , b.create_by, sysdate, b.remark, '0' )
